book_cards.adult_prompt: Point to the attacking goal at the top and the defending goal below. Choose without a countdown, then compare the feedback.
book_cards.summary: You are the player with the green ring. Blue players are teammates; coral players are opponents.
book_cards.title: Start with a picture

book_cards.adult_prompt: Ask the child to explain one option. Use coach comparison or retry; first attempts remain separate from later practice.
book_cards.summary: Watch pressure, space and ready teammates. An arrow shows a route, not a guaranteed result.
book_cards.title: Read the playbook

book_cards.adult_prompt: Ask a coach to demonstrate a gentle thigh or chest cushion. Notice where the next touch can go; do not score contact technique.
book_cards.summary: Schematic: a high arrival settles near the feet. This screen does not assess body contact.
book_cards.title: Thigh and chest control

book_cards.adult_prompt: Stand a few comfortable steps apart. Signal readiness before passing and discuss the receiver's next touch.
book_cards.summary: Compare a nearby receiver with a long kick. Use enough weight to reach the ready partner.
book_cards.title: A short delivery

book_cards.adult_prompt: With a coach, vary a comfortable passing distance. Ask whether the ball reaches the partner without forcing a difficult first touch.
book_cards.summary: A farther receiver needs a clear lane and suitable weight. Distance alone does not make a pass better.
book_cards.title: A medium delivery

book_cards.adult_prompt: Ask a coach to choose an appropriate distance and demonstrate delivery. Compare the landing space with the safer short outlet.
book_cards.summary: The lifted route illustrates travel to distant space. Check the receiver and landing area before choosing it.
book_cards.title: A longer delivery

book_cards.adult_prompt: Set route gates with a coach and discuss when a curve helps. Learn physical inside-foot contact from the demonstration, not a mouse click.
book_cards.summary: A curved ground route reaches the partner from one side. It is a path diagram, not a foot-placement lesson.
book_cards.title: An inside bend

book_cards.adult_prompt: Let a coach set a short suitable activity. Discuss the landing space and an available ground pass before practicing a lifted touch.
book_cards.summary: Compare a lifted arc with a ground delivery. The partner needs usable space where the ball lands.
book_cards.title: A lifted chip

book_cards.adult_prompt: Ask a coach to demonstrate controlled contact with an appropriate soft feed. Discuss when settling the ball would be preferable.
book_cards.summary: The incoming path reaches a contact point before the outgoing route. The ball stays above ground at illustrated contact.
book_cards.title: Meet a volley

book_cards.adult_prompt: With a coach, choose an appropriate practice spot and target. Discuss preparation and repeatability without promising a goal.
book_cards.summary: Rehearse a calm routine and an intended target. This unscored diagram does not measure accuracy or power.
book_cards.title: A penalty routine

book_cards.adult_prompt: Try a few comfortable touches, allow a bounce, and restart cheerfully. No software score claims the child has mastered juggling.
book_cards.summary: Repeated rises and settles represent ball familiarity, not a required juggling count.
book_cards.title: Get familiar with the ball

book_cards.adult_prompt: Ask a coach to show appropriate outside-foot contact, then compare which route is useful. The diagram illustrates path shape only.
book_cards.summary: Compare the curve from the other side with a straight path to the same partner.
book_cards.title: An outside bend

book_cards.adult_prompt: Use a ground-ball alternative. Review the child's age, local rules and coaching guidance before any separate heading instruction.
book_cards.summary: Heading drills are not enabled in your profile. This entry records the chapter without claiming to teach its technique.
book_cards.title: Heading: overview only

book_cards.adult_prompt: Use an adult-selected clip if available, or the schematic. Ask what the player can see; no particular match or book anecdote is asserted.
book_cards.summary: Find the receiver before the delivery. This is an original observation prompt, not a biographical quiz.
book_cards.title: Watch David Beckham

book_cards.adult_prompt: Use an adult-selected clip if available, or the schematic. Ask what the player can see; no particular match or book anecdote is asserted.
book_cards.summary: Watch the player's position before the ball arrives. This is an original observation prompt, not a biographical quiz.
book_cards.title: Watch Christine Sinclair

book_cards.adult_prompt: Use an adult-selected clip if available, or the schematic. Ask what the player can see; no particular match or book anecdote is asserted.
book_cards.summary: Notice an off-ball run that helps a teammate. This is an original observation prompt, not a biographical quiz.
book_cards.title: Watch Mia Hamm

book_cards.adult_prompt: Use an adult-selected clip if available, or the schematic. Ask what the player can see; no particular match or book anecdote is asserted.
book_cards.summary: Compare a carrying lane with a passing option. This is an original observation prompt, not a biographical quiz.
book_cards.title: Watch Lionel Messi

book_cards.adult_prompt: Use an adult-selected clip if available, or the schematic. Ask what the player can see; no particular match or book anecdote is asserted.
book_cards.summary: Pause before a scoring run and find the available space. This is an original observation prompt, not a biographical quiz.
book_cards.title: Watch Alex Morgan

book_cards.adult_prompt: Use an adult-selected clip if available, or the schematic. Ask what the player can see; no particular match or book anecdote is asserted.
book_cards.summary: Watch how the player prepares for the next action. This is an original observation prompt, not a biographical quiz.
book_cards.title: Watch Cristiano Ronaldo

book_cards.adult_prompt: Invite the child to name one thing they noticed. Discuss effort and learning without turning this card into another score.
book_cards.summary: Success can include a better observation, useful choice or enjoyable practice.
book_cards.title: Notice progress

book_cards.adult_prompt: Offer a choice of two short activities. Let the child pause or stop, and agree on one thing to notice rather than a compulsory target.
book_cards.summary: Keep the next optional activity small and enjoyable.
book_cards.title: Make practice inviting

book_cards.adult_prompt: Before revealing a coach route, ask which space the child sees. Listen to their reason instead of calling every answer for them.
book_cards.summary: Ask useful questions and let the child make the decision.
book_cards.title: An adult's role

book_cards.adult_prompt: Choose one supportive phrase before the match. Discuss local coach guidance for sideline behavior rather than giving competing instructions.
book_cards.summary: Encouragement and room to decide help keep play enjoyable.
book_cards.title: Support on match day

book_cards.adult_prompt: Ask whether they want to talk about play. If so, start with what they enjoyed and one next step they choose themselves.
book_cards.summary: Let the child describe a memorable moment before offering advice.
book_cards.title: Listen after play

starter_cards.adult_prompt: Gently roll a ball toward either foot, ask your child to take one soft side touch, then call out what is ahead.
starter_cards.summary: Cushion the rolling ball away from the marker cone and look up before your next step.
starter_cards.title: Touch and look

starter_cards.adult_prompt: Count six calm touches alternating feet in the yard; celebrate smooth balance rather than speed.
starter_cards.summary: Practice gentle side-to-side touches using both left and right feet at a comfortable pace.
starter_cards.title: Two-foot explorer

starter_cards.adult_prompt: Stand ten steps apart, hold up a hand when ready, and take turns rolling smooth ground passes to each foot.
starter_cards.summary: Compare a firm ground pass to feet with a pass played gently into a teammate's path.
starter_cards.title: Friendly delivery

starter_cards.adult_prompt: Use a stationary ball: stand passively behind your child and let them practice stepping across to shield.
starter_cards.summary: Place your body between the opponent and the ball while keeping the ball within one step.
starter_cards.title: Keep it close

starter_cards.adult_prompt: Set two cones as a goal, stand on one side as keeper, and ask your child to point to the open side before kicking.
starter_cards.summary: Spot the open side of the goal past the goalkeeper before striking a settled ball.
starter_cards.title: Find the window

starter_cards.adult_prompt: When watching a match together, pause before a pass arrives and ask: 'Who is open and where is the pressure?'
starter_cards.summary: Observe how a midfielder scans left and right before the ball arrives at their feet.
starter_cards.title: Watch a player

starter_cards.adult_prompt: After play, ask one friendly question: 'What did you notice before your favorite pass today?'
starter_cards.summary: Connect what changed on the pitch to the decision you chose, one small goal at a time.
starter_cards.title: One good question

choices.explanation: The ball is still running across you. Rushing an off-balance swing often misses when you had time to control.
choices.label: Swing first time off balance.
choices.outcome: Off-balance strike pulls wide of goal.

choices.explanation: Passing to RW can work too, though you have clear space to control the ball in front of goal.
choices.label: Lay it first-time back to RW.
choices.outcome: Ball goes across to RW.

starter_scenes.coach_note: When a fast ball is unsettled and you have room, take a control touch first.
starter_scenes.cue: A fast pass arrives across your body. Space ahead is clear.
starter_scenes.focus: Compare a clear shooting window with passing or settling the ball.
starter_scenes.rules: Full field: attack upward toward (50, 0); defend (50, 100).
starter_scenes.title: Use the shooting window

choices.explanation: Slow the attack and stay balanced. Wait for a touch you can actually reach.
choices.label: Stay goal-side and match A's run.
choices.outcome: You delay A along the goal-side lane.

choices.explanation: A small controlled approach can help. Keep enough room to react instead of diving in.
choices.label: Close a little and get set.
choices.outcome: You take a small balanced step toward A.

choices.explanation: A still controls it. A hopeful reach can leave you off balance and open the route to goal.
choices.label: Lunge at the controlled ball.
choices.outcome: You lunge while A still has close control.

starter_scenes.coach_note: Stay goal-side on your feet while A keeps the ball close.
starter_scenes.cue: A runs with the ball close. You are between A and goal.
starter_scenes.focus: Distinguish controlled dribbling from a loose touch or pass.
starter_scenes.rules: Full field: attack upward toward (50, 0); defend (50, 100).
starter_scenes.title: Delay a controlled dribbler

choices.explanation: A's heavy touch is closer to you than to A. Step in cleanly and take control.
choices.label: Step in and win the loose ball.
choices.outcome: You reach the exposed touch first and win control.

choices.explanation: Staying goal-side is safe, but backing off here lets A recover a loose touch you could win.
choices.label: Keep backing off toward goal.
choices.outcome: You drop deeper while the loose ball sits free.

choices.explanation: You have time to step to the ball cleanly. Swinging from afar risks missing or slicing it inside.
choices.label: Swing wildly without getting set.
choices.outcome: Rushed swing sends the ball into the middle.

starter_scenes.coach_note: Step in firmly when a heavy touch puts the ball within your reach first.
starter_scenes.cue: A pushes a heavy touch toward you. You are closer to the ball.
starter_scenes.focus: Distinguish controlled dribbling from a loose touch or pass.
starter_scenes.rules: Full field: attack upward toward (50, 0); defend (50, 100).
starter_scenes.title: Delay a controlled dribbler

choices.explanation: Sprint back on the inside line toward your goal so you can get between R and the net.
choices.label: Recover goal-side toward R and goal.
choices.outcome: You recover on the inside goal-side angle.

choices.explanation: A no longer has the ball. Watching the passer leaves R free in front of your goal.
choices.label: Stay with A after the pass.
choices.outcome: You stay high by A while R attacks the box.

choices.explanation: Running straight at R's back is slower than taking the shorter diagonal toward your goal.
choices.label: Chase directly at R's heels.
choices.outcome: You chase behind R.

starter_scenes.coach_note: When the ball is played past you, take the direct inside recovery line toward goal.
starter_scenes.cue: A passes past you to R ahead. R is moving toward goal.
starter_scenes.focus: Distinguish controlled dribbling from a loose touch or pass.
starter_scenes.rules: Full field: attack upward toward (50, 0); defend (50, 100).

choices.explanation: M presses while you cover. Keep seeing A and R; N's marking may still change.
choices.label: Stay behind M and protect the inside gap.
choices.outcome: You hold a balanced cover angle behind M.

choices.explanation: Both defenders chasing A leaves the gap behind. Help M without doing the same job.
choices.label: Run past M toward A.
choices.outcome: You duplicate M's press and vacate central cover.

choices.explanation: Deeper cover can protect goal too. Stay connected so the gap behind M does not grow too large.
choices.label: Keep a deeper central position.
choices.outcome: You drop deeper in front of the box.

starter_scenes.coach_note: Cover behind the pressing teammate instead of doubling on the ball.
starter_scenes.cue: M closes A. N watches R. You can help behind M.
starter_scenes.focus: Adjust cover depth and watch for unmarked runners.
starter_scenes.rules: Full field: attack upward toward (50, 0); defend (50, 100).
starter_scenes.title: Cover a pressing teammate

choices.explanation: Because you had cover depth, step onto A's line to goal and slow the attack while M recovers.
choices.label: Step across to delay A goal-side.
choices.outcome: You step into A's path and delay the drive.

choices.explanation: Dropping all the way to GK gives A a free shot from the middle of the box.
choices.label: Keep backing into the goalkeeper.
choices.outcome: You retreat too deep and leave the box open.

choices.explanation: Lunging high gives A a chance to knock the ball past you too. Delay on your feet first.
choices.label: Dive past A's front foot.
choices.outcome: You lunge past A's dribble line.

starter_scenes.coach_note: When your pressing teammate is beaten, step smoothly from cover into delay.
starter_scenes.cue: A beats M and drives toward the box. You are in cover.
starter_scenes.focus: Adjust cover depth and watch for unmarked runners.
starter_scenes.rules: Full field: attack upward toward (50, 0); defend (50, 100).
starter_scenes.title: Cover a pressing teammate

choices.explanation: M already delays A. Moving toward the ball leaves R completely free in front of goal.
choices.label: Step toward M and leave R free.
choices.outcome: You move left while R runs free in the center.

choices.explanation: M handles the ball carrier. Adjust goal-side of R to close the most dangerous open runner.
choices.label: Shift across to track unmarked R.
choices.outcome: You slide across goal-side of unmarked R.

choices.explanation: Splitting the space helps, though shifting closer to R better protects the open central pass.
choices.label: Hold halfway between M and R.
choices.outcome: You hold a middle position.

starter_scenes.coach_note: Scan away from the ball: when a central runner is unmarked, protect that threat.
starter_scenes.cue: M delays A. N is caught high, leaving R unmarked in the middle.
starter_scenes.focus: Adjust cover depth and watch for unmarked runners.
starter_scenes.rules: Full field: attack upward toward (50, 0); defend (50, 100).
starter_scenes.title: Cover a pressing teammate

choices.explanation: Reach the loose pass first. Get control, then look for a teammate.
choices.label: Step into the pass and take control.
choices.outcome: You intercept the slow pass cleanly.

choices.explanation: Recovering is reasonable if you cannot arrive. Here the slow loose pass is within your reach.
choices.label: Recover closer to goal.
choices.outcome: You drop back toward the box.

choices.explanation: A has already passed. Chasing the passer lets the live ball travel into space behind you.
choices.label: Chase the player who passed.
choices.outcome: You run at A while the pass rolls behind you.

starter_scenes.coach_note: Step in and intercept when the rolling pass is clearly closer to you.
starter_scenes.cue: The loose pass crosses your path. A is farther away.
starter_scenes.focus: Read whether you, an opponent, or a teammate will reach the ball first.
starter_scenes.rules: Full field: attack upward toward (50, 0); defend (50, 100).
starter_scenes.title: React to a reachable loose pass

choices.explanation: The pass already arrived. Charging past R's front side lets R turn toward your goal.
choices.label: Charge past R for an interception.
choices.outcome: You charge past R and open the goal-side lane.

choices.explanation: When the pass is already controlled, close the angle on your feet and delay R's next move.
choices.label: Get set between R and your goal.
choices.outcome: You get set goal-side in front of R.

choices.explanation: Protecting depth is reasonable, though stepping into R's line at (46, 73) stops R advancing freely.
choices.label: Drop deeper into the penalty box.
choices.outcome: You retreat into the box.

starter_scenes.coach_note: Do not gamble for an interception after the receiver already has control.
starter_scenes.cue: R already controls the pass ahead of you. You are goal-side.

choices.explanation: CM already won the ball. Running to the same spot crowds your teammate and brings pressure.
choices.label: Run into CM's space for the ball.
choices.outcome: You crowd CM near A.

choices.explanation: Since CM won possession, spread out to give CM a clear outlet away from A.
choices.label: Open a wide left passing angle.
choices.outcome: You move wide left to give CM a clean pass option.

choices.explanation: Staying behind CM gives a safe back option too, while wide support helps move play forward.
choices.label: Hold deeper behind CM as cover.
choices.outcome: You drop behind CM as a safety outlet.

starter_scenes.coach_note: When a teammate wins the loose ball, spread out to offer a clean passing outlet.
